7. The Hollowing Anchor
Deep beneath the ice of West Antarctica, warm seawater is carving out a void two-thirds the size of Manhattan, acting like a hidden cancer within the planet's cryosphere. This glacier serves as the structural "plug" for an entire ice sheet; if it goes, the resulting sea-level rise would be measured in meters, not centimeters. It is currently hollowing out at a pace that has left NASA’s most pessimistic models in the dust. Identify this "Doomsday Glacier."
